title: Internet vs Website
drDigitalIntro:
The internet and a website are not the same thing — here is how they fit together.
• The internet is a giant network of millions of computers all connected to each other. It is always running, even when you are not using it.
• A website is one specific place on that network — like a shop, a library, or a newspaper that lives at its own address.
• The browser is the app you use to travel to websites. It reads the address, finds the site on the internet, and shows it to you.
• Think of it this way: the internet is the road system, websites are the buildings along the road, and your browser is the car.
• You do not need to understand how the internet works to use it — you just need to know the address of where you want to go.

playgroundTask.goal: Use your browser to visit a website on the internet

steps.say: The browser is your car. Type citylibrary.example in the address bar and press Enter to drive there.

drDigitalSuccess: You used the browser (your car) to travel on the internet (the road system) and arrive at a website (the library building). That is all browsing the web is.
drDigitalHint: Click the address bar at the top, type citylibrary.example, then press Enter or click the Go button.
